unavailableDescription: The image could not be analyzed. No findings were produced. Try again or ask your care team to review the original image.
draftDescription: AI-generated content requires review by a qualified clinician. It is not a confirmed radiology report.
uploadDescription: Submit an image for an AI-generated draft for clinician review.
emptyDescription: Select an image to request an AI draft. No clinical findings are available before a successful response.
prompt: Describe the provided imaging scan as an unreviewed AI draft for a qualified clinician. Clearly state uncertainty and limitations.
downloadDescription: Your browser handles the download. Review the draft with a clinician before using it.
